# Anthony Tulk

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony Tulk has a small, dark, and gloomy face. He features black eyes that cast an intense glare.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

Anthony Tulk projects an impertinent swagger and a somewhat cheeky demeanor. Beneath this posture, he maintains a sullen look and a contemptuous attitude.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## History

Anthony Tulk, an orphaned nephew of Mrs. Laurence Tulk's husband, was taken in by his aunt. While attending school in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), he placed a mouse in his teacher Nell's desk, prompting her to whip him after she lost her temper. Surprisingly, Anthony showed respect for her actions the next morning, though he and his classmates were later left dismayed when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigned from her teaching position.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anthony-tulk--nell-harcourt.md)

Anthony Tulk is a student taught by [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Their dynamic took a dramatic turn when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) lost her temper and whipped Anthony after discovering he had placed a mouse inside her school desk. Rather than harboring resentment, Anthony unexpectedly showed respect toward [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for her decisive response the following day, though he and his classmates were later left dismayed when she resigned her teaching post to pursue further education.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), +6 more_
